title: Scene 1 - Greener but policy-violating: blocked
description: A sample Japan-only data residency policy. The change moves a VM from Tokyo to Paris. Paris is far cleaner on the grid (16 vs 449 gCO2eq/kWh), but the policy gate blocks it. This is a synthetic demo policy, not a claim about real financial regulation.
